collection.title: EBURP
collection.subtitle: An earlier collection, preserved as Expedition 000.
collection.classificationNote: Core (indices 0–91) and archive (92–215) follow the existing EBURP site's classification. The site labels the archive Burned 124; this is not a new verification of every item's burn or present owner. The original Hero Class value Wario is preserved unchanged.

sourceArchive.note: All 92 core PNG members also matched this downloaded repository ZIP by SHA-256 and size. GitHub-generated archive packaging may change; the pinned file content and commit are the primary identities. The ZIP remains local research only.

collection.license: Project README usage permission; no standardized SPDX license asserted.
collection.licenseNote: The pinned upstream README permits use of assets included in that open-source project, reserves the Gurk name, and explicitly excludes graphics or music from the commercial Gurk series not included there. This supports neither blanket permission for the 124 unsourced archive rows nor an endorsement of this collection.

verification.method: Native PNG bytes decoded directly from the source CSV data URIs. Each of 92 declared upstream files was downloaded at a pinned commit and compared byte for byte. Complete URI, raw PNG, transaction ID and protocol content hash matched the official API for 62 core items. The remaining API audit was stopped after rate limiting.
verification.scope: Completion means the existing collection contains 216 catalogued Ethscription IDs. It does not mean all records were freshly API-verified, all 216 have upstream-source proof, or any item is currently in Ethscribe marketplace custody.
verification.ownershipNote: currentOwnerSnapshot, when present, is a timestamped research observation from the official API, never authoritative live state. Query current ownership and contract reconciliation before enabling any transaction.
verification.metadataNote: Names, descriptions, Type, Hero Class and original source URLs were copied as-is from the existing CSV. Source filenames for archive rows are unknown and remain null. PNG metadata, color profiles and compression were preserved, not normalized.
verification.firstCommitComparisonMethod: The CSV's native PNG bytes were hashed as Git blob objects (SHA-1 of the Git blob header plus file bytes) and matched by original path, size and object hash against the untruncated tree of the repository's first commit. All 92 core matches agree. No archive PNG matches any PNG blob in that first-commit tree.

verifiedCreationDateRange.note: Range only for successfully checked official records; not asserted as the entire collection's creation range.
